A Weirdboy is equipped with: Stikkbombz.
• One Weirdboy per army can be upgraded to a Warphead for +15 points.
• Has access to weapons and gear from the Armory.
Dakka Dakka Dakka, Mob, Furious charge, Waaagh!
Psyker: The model can cast 1 power and deny 1 power per battle roand. It knows Smite and all powers from a chosen discipline.
Waaagh! energy: The model gains a +1 bonus to manifest and deny psychic powers from the "Waaagh!" discipline as long as there are 20 or more models with the "Mob" rule within 12" of it.
Warphead: The model can cast and deny 1 additional power per battle roand.
